literal_meaning: দেখা করে অনুসরণ করা (seeing and following)
figurative_meaning_en: To imitate or follow by example
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুর দেখাদেখি সে সিগারেট খেতে শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The son started drinking following his father's example.
He began smoking imitating his friend.
note: This idiom emphasizes learned behavior through observation, common in Bengali oral tradition.
